# TOAST UI Editor

- Version: `3.2.2`
- Package: `@toast-ui/editor`
- License: MIT, included in `LICENSE`
- Upstream: https://github.com/nhn/tui.editor
- Distribution: https://uicdn.toast.com/editor/3.2.2/

Vendored files are the pinned plain-JavaScript all-in-one browser bundle, base CSS,
dark theme CSS, and Spanish locale. They are served locally: the editor has no
runtime CDN dependency and no frontend build pipeline. Documents that do not
round-trip exactly stay in the editor's plain Markdown textarea, so incompatible
raw HTML is never rendered by TOAST UI inside the editor application.
